description: This PHP class, ReviewListAPI, is part of the OrangeHRM Performance plugin API. It provides an endpoint to retrieve a list of performance reviews with filtering, sorting, and pagination support. The class extends PerformanceReviewAPI and utilizes traits for performance review services and authentication. It defines methods for fetching review data, validation rules, and handles HTTP GET requests for the reviews list.
